reason: A specification-driven development plugin that guides agents through anchoring, specification, assumption verification, implementation, and acceptance auditing, with templates and local review tools.

summaries.zh: 一个通过技能、模板和本地审查工具引导智能体先编写规格、验证假设并按验收标准实施与审计的软件开发工作流插件。
summaries.en: A development workflow plugin that guides agents to write specifications, verify assumptions, control scope, and audit implementation against acceptance criteria using skills, templates, and local review tools.

capabilities: Provides skills and prompts that guide specification-first development workflows
Reviews specification, assumption, and audit files with rule-based findings
Integrates with a harness or runs as a local Node.js CLI
